instruction: Extract the audio from the music video file and save it as an MP3 file named 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting audio from MP4 video and converting to MP3 format using VLC Media Player. Evaluator checks: (1) File exists at correct location (40%), (2) Filename is correct (30%), (3) Extension is .mp3 (20%), (4) File size is reasonable (>100KB, 10%). This ensures the conversion was completed successfully without comparing audio content.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking file system state - file existence, correct filename 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3', .mp3 extension, and minimum file size of 100KB to ensure non-empty audio file was created.

Getter logic correctly extracts file system state (existence, size, extension, filename) using appropriate Python file system operations via env.controller.execute_python_command()
Metric logic correctly compares all aspects with proper weighted scoring: existence (40%), filename match (30%), extension (20%), minimum size (10%)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts file properties dict → metric compares against expected rules dict
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses expected.get('filename'), expected.get('extension'), expected.get('min_size') which matches the rules dict returned by get_rule()
